dependencies.installation: baseline dependency state; no installation during run

filesystem_policy: fresh detached worktree; writes limited to task allowed surface; append-only evidence recorder outside
limitation: The host exposes neither an immutable model/service revision nor runner build/container digest. This identity is insufficient to satisfy the preregistered runner freeze and must remain BLOCKED.
repair: one agent-initiated repair in the same run; no evaluator feedback
retry: none after completed invocation; one logged retry only for pre-invocation infrastructure failure
